reviews.text:
Very skilled and patient. Takes the time to let the animal de-stress before giving injections.

Very good follow-up afterwards.
Great service ! Thanks for taking care of my cat.

Great service , Thanks to the team there for taking care of my cat twice this month ❤️ Special thanks to Isabelle for being so kind and Assisting us with our concerns ! Definitely recommend them for taking care of your pets!
Have been to Empet Røa several times. They have been very good with my dog. Nice staff. Very helpful. They are quite expensive, but definitely worth the visit. Can recommend.

We have brought Pelle here because the vets take their time with the dog.
The times when we have needed extra treatment they have taken the time to examine and follow up.
Helpful and flexible. A pleasure to deal with!

What an amazing team! They cleaned my dog’s teeth and, after she woke up from anesthesia, they took her for a walk, fed her, and even carried her around like a baby because she didn’t like being inside the cage they use for post-surgery recovery. 🥰 Thank you for taking such great care of Gaja!❤️ …
Excellent service, very professional and friendly staff.
